# The Light of the World (John 8:12)

## Emotional Focus
Jesus brings light into dark places.

## Key KJV
“I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness.” (John 8:12)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said He is the light of the world. When we follow Him we never have to walk in the dark.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus holding a bright lamp while a child walks beside Him in soft light.

## Read-along flow + response
“Jesus is your light. You never have to be afraid of the dark.”
